name: coin-nobudget
description: One coin in an1_02, which has NO assign_tbl entry at all.
_comment: he1_01 (budget 4) and he2_02 (budget 29) both asserted on one coin, because
their budgets were already spent by block coins. an1_02 is one of the 204
maps with a setup file and no budget entry, so the allocator returns -1
rather than asserting -- and swGetCoinCollected @ 0x8003875c reads -1 as
'not collected' and returns 0. PREDICTION: it spawns and the map loads.
The overlay is hand-written because bleck refuses this file (D130).
an1_02 places 15 enemies, so the NPC count is the control.
